point.title: Live Canvas Agent Protocol
point.rationale: AgentDiagrammingSessionService binds tools to specific canvases and documents, validates requests, and manages retry-safe execution. Commands travel through a polling bridge to the browser; a separate live service distributes selection/context updates over sockets. Compact projections and revision guards keep agent references tied to the correct state.
